admissibility_law: Every hard gate must be PASS. UNKNOWN blocks current selection without asserting scientific null; FAIL blocks this exact proposal only. Calibration possibility is required, not completed power or error-control trials.
minimal_discriminator_law: Address the first unsatisfied necessary scientific gate before acquiring more price history. A semantic identification certificate can resolve deterministic redundancy without market outcomes. It may reduce contenders; it cannot guarantee a unique winner or replace later path and burden evidence.
objective: Maximize rate of genuine decision-relevant economic information per time and resource, constrained by causal identification, valid inference, execution realism and capital survival; no historical edge prior.

partial_order.dominance: A dominates B only if all 13 pairwise comparisons are certified nonworse and at least one scientifically relevant information/identification/inference/execution/generalization dimension is strictly better. Convenience-only improvements cannot establish information preference.
partial_order.objective_burden_law: Compare data, compute and time burdens only with auditable bounds. Qualitative availability is not a bound on economic information rate. No weighted score, numeric VOI, outcome prior, candidate ID or random tiebreak.
partial_order.tie: Multiple nondominated or incomparable possibilities means unresolved.
partial_order.unique_choice: Require exactly one currently admissible candidate to robustly dominate every other not-failed candidate. Unresolved candidates remain possible competitors; they cannot be discarded merely because certification is missing.

project_adaptivity: Prior research and adaptive selection history are not erased. Future development survivors require selection payment and genuinely disjoint confirmation.
